name: OSM Icons
about: OSM Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 169 icons designed by GMGeo. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC0 1.0.

faqs.q: Are OSM Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 169 OSM Icons are open source under the CC0 1.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC0 1.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use OSM Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many OSM Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 169 icons in the OSM Icons set, designed by GMGeo. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of OSM Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are OSM Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
